subject: Concierge SME ops + slide anchoring for Apr 12 webinar with Acme AI
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Mills <sophie.mills@eventco.com>, Priya Shah <priya@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Concierge SME ops + slide anchoring for Apr 12 webinar with Acme AI

Team —

We have the Apr 12 webinar with Acme AI (guest: Priya Shah). High-level ask: nominate a single concierge SME who will own greenroom coordination (audio/video checks, demo handoffs) and be the "slide anchor" during the session (manage slide timing, call-outs, and speaker cueing).

Notes / constraints:
- Live demo will run ~10 minutes; we need a technical dry run with Priya and our demo infra.
- Event platform contact Sophie is copied — they need a single point of contact for day-of.
- Attach: demo-checklist.xlsx (please review), initial-agenda.docx.

Can I get volunteers by EOD today? If you volunteer, please confirm a backup and whether you can run a 15-min tech dry run on Apr 9 (prefer morning PT).

Thanks — I want to avoid last-minute scramble like the last panel.

—
Michael Grant
Head of Field Marketing (events)
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Michael —

Happy to take concierge SME for greenroom ops and be the slide anchor on Apr 12. I can run AV checks and handle slide timing. I will ask Jen (ops) to be my backup; she can step in 10 mins prior if I'm pulled into a sales call.

I reviewed the demo-checklist.xlsx and left inline comments on the network section (we should pin Priya to a wired connection for the demo).

Provisional availability for dry run: Apr 9 09:00 PT works for me. Karthik, can you give a quick thumbs-up on the demo infra readiness?

Thanks —
Lauren
Sr. Event Producer
Redwood Inference

Michael / Lauren —

I can own the slide anchoring script and the demo kill-switch. Proposed tweaks to the checklist:
- Add explicit step to warm KV cache for demo model with short warm-up traffic (30s)
- Confirm quantization profile used in demo VM (we should use q4_0 for latency parity)
- Add a network fallback instruction: if participant audio drops, Lauren will switch to pre-recorded demo snippet at T+2m

I created timeline-v1.xlsx (attached) with a 15-min dry run slot Apr 9 09:00 PT. Priya — can you confirm you have access to the demo account I shared (acme-demo-token) and that Apr 9 09:00 PT works? If not, propose alternative windows Apr 8 morning or Apr 10 morning.

Attaching timeline-v1.xlsx — Laura/Soojin, please add the measurement buckets you want captured during the run (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mem).

Thanks —
Karthik
Platform Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
